藏品名称_EN: the blue skies project – ss – baubrigaden – alderney (kanalinsel) (ss-bb i), 0000700
藏品名称_ZN: 蓝天计划--SS--baubrigaden--奥尔德尼岛（袚芯褉芯写）（SS-BB I），0000700
描述_EN: anton kusters is a belgian multidisciplinary visual artist who lives and works in belgium and tokyo. kusters’ unique documentary approach is based on his use of a polaroid camera, known for its immediacy, to create pictures that operate at the border of abstract photography rather than providing a representational image. made on september 13, 2017, the photograph is the last taken during kusters’ five-year journey, and marks the end of his series. the single polaroid proposed was made in alderney, which housed an ‘ss-baubrigade i’ camp – the only nazi camp to ever exist on british soil – used to build fortifications on enemy territory. his work has been featured in numerous publications and has been exhibited in europe, china and australia. he studied photography at stuk leuven and the academy of fine arts, hasselt. these he tagged with the gps coordinates and the number of deaths estimated at the location. with this, kusters challenges the expectations of his audience and questions the capability of the medium as a reliable witness of historical events. stemming from a documentary approach, kusters is interested in the limits of understanding, the difficulties of representing trauma and loss, and the act of commemoration. for the blue skies project, prompted by his family’s own history, kusters researched locations of nazi camps of detention, persecution, forced labour and murder. travelling to a total of 1,078 locations in europe, kusters made three unique 8 x 10 cm polaroid photographs of the sky as close as possible to each site. such stark data combined with this systematic approach make a chilling reference to the catastrophic efficiency of the nazi’s programme of extermination throughout europe.
描述_ZN: 安东尼-库斯特是一位比利时多学科视觉艺术家，在比利时和东京生活和工作。 库斯特独特的纪实方法是基于他对宝丽来相机的使用，以其即时性而闻名，创造出在抽象摄影的边界运作的照片，而不是提供一个代表性的图像。 拍摄于2017年9月13日，这张照片是库斯特五年旅程中拍摄的最后一张，也标志着他的系列作品的结束。 所提出的单张宝丽来照片是在阿尔德尼岛拍摄的，那里有一个 "SS-Baubrigade I "营地--唯一存在于英国土地上的纳粹营地，用来在敌人的领土上建造防御工事。 他的作品已经在许多出版物中出现，并在欧洲、中国和澳大利亚展出。 他在stuk leuven和美术学院学习摄影，Hassselt。 他在这些照片上标注了GPS坐标和在该地点的估计死亡人数。 有了这些，库斯特挑战了他的观众的期望，并质疑这种媒介作为历史事件的可靠证人的能力。 源自于纪录片的方法，Kusters对理解的局限性、表现创伤和损失的困难以及纪念的行为感兴趣。 在蓝天项目中，在他的家庭历史的促使下，库斯特研究了纳粹的拘留营、迫害、强迫劳动和谋杀的地点。 在欧洲总共有1078个地点，库斯特对每个地点的天空拍摄了三张独特的8 x 10厘米的宝丽来照片，并尽可能地靠近。 这种严酷的数据与这种系统性的方法相结合，使人不寒而栗地提到了纳粹在整个欧洲的灭绝计划的灾难性效率。
